benchmark_envelope.workload: deterministic coordination transaction: dependency-DAG validation + material handoff ACK + revision-safe state commit + trace digest
benchmark_envelope.randomization_policy: alternating baseline/candidate order by iteration parity
benchmark_envelope.outlier_policy: retain all finite observations; report p50/p95/max
benchmark_envelope.scope_boundary: Thresholds apply only to this declared microbenchmark envelope; no universal or production-wide performance claim.

protected_dimensions.margin: ZERO observed protected-dimension failures in either candidate or baseline fixtures

C38.pass_rule: candidate must provide all four coordination safeguards (DAG validation, ACK, revision conflict control, trace digest), baseline must lack at least one safeguard, candidate p95 latency overhead ratio <= 1.50, and candidate absolute p95 overhead <= 2.0 ms
C38.fail_rule: protected-dimension failure OR no demonstrated coordination safeguard benefit OR p95 ratio >1.50 OR absolute p95 overhead >2.0 ms
C38.blocked_rule: non-comparable manifests, missing measurements, clock unavailable, or insufficient runs

C45.definition: executed material controls / declared material controls
C45.pass_rule: candidate control density >=1.00; unnecessary-control rate = 0 in declared fixture; protected dimensions noninferior
C45.fail_rule: control density <1.00 OR unnecessary-control rate >0 OR protected-dimension regression
C45.blocked_rule: material-control denominator unavailable or fixture classification unresolved

C46.pass_rule: candidate p95 latency <= baseline p95*1.50 AND candidate absolute p95 overhead <=2.0 ms AND candidate operation-count cost <= baseline operation-count+4; protected dimensions noninferior
C46.fail_rule: any bound exceeded or protected-dimension regression
C46.blocked_rule: baseline/candidate not comparable or required latency/cost observation missing

authority: DERIVED threshold authority granted by explicit human-owner decision; does not alter canonical source text and does not authorize release.
